_comment: Ports listed by Mixtape in addition to the MiyooMini-Ports catalog (same fields, plus an optional inline 'recipe' with the fields described in assets/recipes.json). If MiyooMini-Ports adds the same project, its entry wins.

ports.name: Panel Attack
ports.notes: Unofficial, modified port of Panel Attack (the Tetris Attack / Puzzle League clone by the Panel Attack team, panelattack.com), not supported by them: report bugs to the port's GitHub, not to the Panel Attack team. Installs to Games > Ports (needs OnionOS's Ports system). Online play is off for now.

ports.name: MiniAmp
ports.notes: Classic-skin music player: MP3/FLAC/OGG/WAV, .wsz skins with a skin browser, 10-band EQ, visualizers. Music in games: keep listening in the menu, games and apps (SELECT+L/R skip). Add skins to MiniAmp/skins.

ports.name: Rewind
ports.notes: New movies on streaming with Rotten Tomatoes, IMDb and Metacritic scores, cast, ratings and trailers (QR to your phone). Sort and filter, and send movies to Radarr. Needs free TMDB and OMDb API keys in App/Rewind/data/config.json; it shows QR codes for both on first launch.

ports.name: Cablebox
ports.notes: TV guide in an 80s cable-box style: browse shows by channel (new, this week, popular, each streaming service, each genre) or search by name, with IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores, cast and trailers (QR to your phone). Order shows into Sonarr: new episodes, everything, or chosen seasons or episodes. Needs free TMDB and OMDb keys (uses Rewind's if installed).

ports.name: Carrier
ports.notes: qBittorrent remote with a retro modem look: watch progress and speeds, filter and sort torrents, stop, start, force start, recheck, set categories and file priorities, toggle slow mode, and remove torrents with or without their files. Needs your qBittorrent Web UI address (and login) in App/Carrier/data/config.json.

ports.name: Flashback
ports.notes: Anki flashcards: study shared AnkiWeb decks (.apkg) with spaced repetition, browse or shuffle them. Cloze, image occlusion, pictures, readable maths and Japanese/Chinese/Korean. Download decks on a computer from ankiweb.net/shared/decks and copy them to the Anki folder on your SD card.

ports.name: Cyberspace.miyoo
ports.notes: Client for cyberspace.online, the text-only social network, released with its developer's blessing: feed, topics, threaded replies, alerts and posting, plus C-Mail and cIRC chat with live updates. Three themes like the site. Needs a Cyberspace account with a verified email. Not made by Cyberspace: report bugs to its GitHub.

ports.name: Mr. Rescue
ports.notes: Unofficial port of Mr. Rescue, the arcade firefighting game by Tangram Games: fight fires and throw people out of windows to safety. Report bugs to the port's GitHub, not to Tangram Games. Installs to Games > Ports (needs OnionOS's Ports system). B jump, A grab/throw, Y shoot.

ports.name: Spelunky Classic
ports.notes: DEPRECATED: no longer maintained. Use Spelunky Classic (chawinyaw) instead, which runs better. Both install to the same folder, so erase this one first. Unofficial mod: dbeef's Spelunky-PSP remake of Derek Yu's Spelunky Classic (c) 2008-2009 Derek Yu and Mossmouth, LLC. Not made or supported by Mossmouth or dbeef.

ports.name: Spelunky Classic (chawinyaw)
ports.notes: Fan port of Spelunky Classic from dbeef's spelunky-psp, by chawinyaw. The Caves area only; the intro and tutorial aren't playable. Buttons can be remapped in controls.txt. Not affiliated with Derek Yu or Mossmouth. Free, not for sale. Installs to Games > Ports. If you have the old Spelunky Classic, erase it first: both use the same folder.

ports.name: Gravity Circuit
ports.notes: Unofficial port of Gravity Circuit, the action platformer by Domesticated Ant Games. Mostly playable, with some frame rate drops. Needs your own copy: put GravityCircuit.exe (Windows version) or the GravityCircuit program from inside the Linux AppImage in Roms/PORTS/Games/GravityCircuit/. The first start copies the game out of it (a few minutes, about 700 MB free needed). Report bugs to the port's GitHub, not to Domesticated Ant Games.

recipe.note: Now copy GravityCircuit.exe (or the GravityCircuit program from the Linux AppImage) from your copy of the game into Roms/PORTS/Games/GravityCircuit/, then launch it from Games > Ports.

ports.name: Hexen II
ports.notes: uHexen2 (Hammer of Thyrion) port with a dual-core software renderer: 640x480 at 50-60 FPS, no overclock. Needs the GOG version: copy everything in its data1 folder into Roms/PORTS/Games/Hexen2/data1/, plus its music folder there for the soundtrack (optional). Original game only, no Portal of Praevus or multiplayer.

ports.name: Mario Kart 64
ports.notes: Native port from the Mario Kart 64 decompilation (via jnmartin84's Dreamcast port): 640x480 at up to 60 FPS in single-player, full sound, saved records and ghosts. Needs your own USA ROM (.z64, .n64, .v64 or .zip) in Roms/PORTS/Games/MarioKart64/. First start builds the game data (about 5 minutes, once). Don't install it next to Mario Kart 64 (Miyoo64): both use the same Ports shortcut.

ports.name: Minecraft
ports.notes: Runs your own Android Minecraft in software: Pocket Edition 0.8.1 (about 25 FPS, recommended) or Bedrock 1.2.20.2 (5-8 FPS). Needs your own 32-bit armeabi-v7a APK: Pocket Edition in App/Minecraft/apk/, Bedrock in App/mcpe/apk/. Needs about 1 GB free. Not made or approved by Mojang or Microsoft.

ports.name: SkiFree
ports.notes: Unofficial port of Chris Pirih's 1991 Windows classic, from the SkiFree decompilation. Ready to run, nothing else to download. Smooth 60 FPS at the original game speed, high scores with your name. Menu+Start toggles the original 25 FPS, Menu+Select shows high scores.

ports.name: RomManager
ports.notes: On-device ROM downloader and manager: add your own sources (archive.org items, web folders or an FTP server on your PC), queue downloads over Wi-Fi in the background with box art, then play, favorite or delete games. Includes no games and links to none: only download games you own.

ports.name: Space Shooter
ports.notes: Original 60-second polygon space shooter in the Starfox style. Shoot the cyan drones and gold cubes, dodge asteroids, pylons and beams, and survive the minute for a bonus. A to fire, D-pad to fly, L/R to bank. Music toggles with SELECT. Built by Claude for snyderman3000.

ports.name: Plants vs. Zombies
ports.notes: Native port of Plants vs. Zombies GOTY from the PvZ-Portable decompilation, with grid D-pad controls and auto-collected sun. Needs main.pak from your own PC copy (Steam, EA App or Origin) in Roms/PORTS/Games/Plants vs. Zombies/. The first launch converts it for the Miyoo (the progress screen looks glitchy; let it finish). Not made or supported by PopCap or EA.

ports.name: Risk of Rain
ports.notes: Port of Risk of Rain (2013) on a custom Butterscotch GameMaker runtime, with 1.25x and 1.5x zoom (Audio and Video > Zoom Scale). Mostly smooth, dipping to about 40 FPS in busy fights. Needs data.win and all the .ogg files from your own Steam or GOG copy in Roms/PORTS/Games/Risk of Rain/. Linux copies have game.unx instead: copy it and rename it data.win. Not made or supported by Hopoo Games.
